purpose: Fotografías para el laboratorio interactivo Medir del capítulo 1 de Física

generation.processing: Resize only to 1024×1024 and encode WebP quality 90; no retouching, compositing, scales or numeric labels baked into images.

coordinate_system: All bounds in final 1024×1024 asset pixel coordinates; use code overlays for exact readings and scales.

assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: realistic science learning website photo asset, 1024x1024 square. A single complete real laboratory digital weighing scale, front view from slightly above, centered product studio photograph on pure white background. White and light gray body, empty horizontal flat brushed stainless steel weighing platform visible on top, LCD display large clean blank pale green rectangle clearly facing directly forward. Platform around 45 percent of image height, display around x35%-65%, y65%-76%. Full object visible, subtle realistic contact shadow, no people or additional objects. Crisp believable physical textures, soft even light, elegant high quality catalog photograph. Display must be completely blank: absolutely no numbers, digits, lettering, brand, logos, marks or tick scales anywhere. The UI will overlay exact readings later. Keep front LCD horizontal and rectangular, not diagonal or trapezoidal. Do not include any weights or objects on platform. No graphic overlay, no illustration.
assets.alt: Balanza digital de laboratorio con plataforma metálica vacía y pantalla LCD.

assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: realistic science learning website photo asset, 1024x1024 square.
